create.name: Deborah Gair
create.bio:
Deborah Gair is a UK-based Quantum-Touch instructor who has taught the method for more than twenty years and helped bring it to Britain, Europe and India. She trained at advanced level directly with Quantum-Touch founder Richard Gordon and with Alain Herriott, in the United States and on Kauai, and in 2004 became one of the first instructors qualified to teach the Supercharging and Core Transformation workshops. Today she is an instructor trainer, an ambassador and a liaison for Quantum-Touch, and she has also taught alongside its founders on The Wonder Method.

Most of her teaching now happens online, through virtual Quantum-Touch workshops from the introductory Level 1 up to Level 5, Becoming Miraculous, with occasional in-person events abroad. She gives private sessions in person, over Zoom or remotely, and hosts a monthly online group, the Life Force Energy Collective, for guided meditation and shared practice. She has also developed approaches of her own: Black Whole Healing, which she frames as a meeting point of science and spirituality, and the Infinity Vortex, which she and Richard Gordon describe receiving on the same day in 2024 and have taught together. Through two further sites she shares teachings from older spiritual traditions.

courses.title: Quantum-Touch private sessions
courses.description: One-to-one Quantum-Touch sessions with Deborah, held in person, over Zoom or offline at a distance. She also offers newer remote session formats built on the same life-force work.

courses.title: Quantum-Touch Level 1: Becoming Energized (virtual)
courses.description: Deborah's online version of the gateway Quantum-Touch workshop, teaching the breathing, intention and body-awareness exercises at the heart of the method, along with chakra work, toning and distance sessions. Her later levels follow on from it.

courses.title: Quantum-Touch Level 5: Becoming Miraculous
courses.description: A fourteen-hour virtual workshop with Deborah over four evenings, on cultivating life-force energy and working with intention to shape the future. Open to those who have completed Level 1; students receive a full-colour manual.

courses.title: Black Whole Healing sessions and course
courses.description: Deborah's own method, which she describes as bridging consciousness, energy and spiritual tradition. It is offered as private sessions and as a virtual course for people who have studied Quantum-Touch Level 1 with her.

courses.title: Infinity Vortex sessions and training
courses.description: Private sessions and personal training in the Infinity Vortex, an energy practice Deborah and Richard Gordon describe as received in 2024 and centred on the timeless nature of the self.
